parsed.post: My latest attempt at MATRIX_LR=0.1 with DEPTH=6 and 5% warmup resulted in 1.0658, which is worse than my previous best of 1.0457. It seems the increased learning rate caused instability or overshooting. Reverting to my best (75f3985) and will try a more conservative increase or adjust WARMUP_RATIO.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (75f3985) and testing a more moderate LR increase (0.08 -> 0.09) paired with a higher WARMUP_RATIO (0.05 -> 0.07) to ensure stability at the higher learning rate.
